description: Single-file Markdown studio: from-scratch Markdown-to-HTML parser (headings, emphasis, lists, tables, fenced code, quotes, links, images), live preview, editor toolbar, scroll sync, word count, autosave and export .md/.html.

criteria: markdown_studio_model_01.html is one self-contained Markdown studio (no libraries): a hand-written parser covering headings, bold/italic/strikethrough, inline code, fenced code blocks, ordered and unordered and nested lists, blockquotes, tables, links, images and horizontal rules — escaping HTML in text nodes, plus live preview as you type, a working toolbar (bold, italic, heading, list, code, link) that wraps or prefixes the selection, synchronized scrolling between editor and preview, word/character/line counts, debounced localStorage autosave, manual save, and export to .md and .html files. The parser must be real; no markdown library or CDN.
